name: Defias Tower Key
summary: In Westfall, the Defias Tower Key marks a quiet passage past Klaven's Tower's sentries. Stormwind operatives need it as proof that an infiltrator slipped by unseen.

sections.title: A Prize from the Twisted Guard
sections.body:
Klaven's Tower is a Defias Brotherhood stronghold on the Westfall coast. Recent shipments from Duskwood brought malformed Defias drones to guard it. The drones are undead and covered in spikes.

SI:7 watchers direct field agents to pick the sentries' pockets instead of fighting them. That way, no alarm sounds as the tower's defenses are breached.

sections.title: Uncovering the Duskwood Connection
sections.body:
The key leads to a chest inside Klaven's Tower, bound with shipments from Duskwood. Inside lies Klaven Mortwake's Journal. When Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind receives it, the journal reveals a conspiracy beyond ordinary highway robbery.

The Defias joined with the Venture Company to traffic specialized troll poisons discovered by Zanzil the Outcast. Those mixtures can raise the dead, explaining the grotesque, coughing abominations around the tower.

faq.q: How do you obtain the Defias Tower Key?
aliases: where do i get the key
how to get defias tower key
faq.answer: Pickpocket one of the malformed Defias drones guarding Klaven's Tower in Westfall. The key cannot be taken from a defeated enemy.

faq.q: What does the Defias Tower Key open?
aliases: does it open the duskwood chest
faq.answer: The key opens neither the tower door nor the Duskwood Chest inside. Master Mathias Shaw requires it as proof that an operative crossed the perimeter unseen.

faq.q: What are the malformed Defias drones guarding the tower?
faq.answer: The malformed Defias drones are grotesque, spiked undead guards around Klaven's Tower. Agent Kearnen does not know what made them and asks operatives to investigate the shipment they guard.

faq.q: Who sends operatives to retrieve this key?
faq.answer: Agent Kearnen, an SI:7 scout watching Klaven's Tower's perimeter, directs field rogues to get the key and retrieve the Duskwood Chest's contents for Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.

angles.text: As a rogue working with SI:7, you use stealth and pickpocketing to acquire the Defias Tower Key. Keep lethal poisons in mind.
As an Alliance member, you help Stormwind investigate the Defias Brotherhood's strange shipments from Duskwood. Secure intelligence from Klaven's Tower.
